compile.description: Compile main sources (fastest loop; 60s timeout to catch hangs)

build.description: Compile + run all unit and black-box e2e tests (120s: full suite)

test.description: Run the full test suite (120s: full suite)

test_class.description: Run a single test class (or Class.method), e.g. LlmRequestTest (re-links installDist first)

lint_scripts.command: bash -n ddr-acp-agent ddr-acp-agent-docker .ai/scripts/*.sh && shellcheck ddr-acp-agent ddr-acp-agent-docker build-docker .ai/scripts/*.sh
lint_scripts.description: Validate launcher, build and .ai helper scripts

test_single_fqn.description: Run a single test class by FQN

show_failures.description: Print failure messages from the latest JUnit XML reports

sdk_sources.description: Extract a *-sources.jar from the Gradle cache to /tmp/acp-sdk-sources for inspection (args: coordinate substring [version])

git.description: Run any git command with arbitrary arguments (e.g. status, diff, log)
